arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions WHERE date >= '2019-10-01' AND date < '2019-11-01'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions dated in October 2019, the part of the requested 1 October 2019 to 31 January 2020 window that the data covers.
assumptions: The data ends on 2019-10-31, so the range was cut to 2019-10-01 through 2019-10-31; November 2019 to January 2020 is not in the data.
Counts every transaction, labelled or not, since the question asks about transactions rather than fraud labels.
Includes transactions with negative amounts, since they are still transactions.
